text.en: Spectrum: block size and window of the FFT behind each point.
text.cs: Spectrum: velikost bloku a okno FFT za každým bodem.

text.en: Live Orders: which orders to draw (Target Orders) and how wide a band around each (Order Width).
text.cs: Live Orders: které řády vykreslit (Target Orders) a jak široké pásmo kolem každého (Order Width).

text.en: Tacho Tracking: Step, Sweep and Hysteresis decide where along the run-up a point is taken.
text.cs: Tacho Tracking: Step, Sweep a Hysteresis určují, kde na rozjezdu se bod odebere.

text.en: Options: Remove DC Offset and Overall Level + Residual.
text.cs: Options: Remove DC Offset a Overall Level + Residual.

text.en: Order curves: amplitude of each order against rpm, one curve per order.
text.cs: Řádové křivky: amplituda každého řádu podle rpm, jedna křivka na řád.

text.en: Evaluation: Max, Top-N maxima, Typed orders or Dominant orders read off the curves.
text.cs: Evaluation: Max, Top-N maxima, Typed orders nebo Dominant orders přečtené z křivek.
